blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
A supply chain is the journey a product takes. It goes from raw materials to the final customer. It starts at a farm, a mine or a factory. It ends in someone's hand or someone's home.

Along the way, many people do a small part. The farmer, the miller, the trucker, the warehouse team and the shop all help. Each one adds a little value. Then each one passes the product forward.

A supply chain sounds complicated. But it is really a long relay race. There are many runners, one baton and the same finish line.

items.q: Where does a supply chain end?
options: At a farm or a mine
items.why: "It ends in someone's hand or someone's home."

items.q: What does each person in the chain do?
options: They add a little value and pass the product forward
They keep the product for themselves
items.why: "Each one adds a little value… passes the product forward."

items.q: The text compares a supply chain to a…
items.why: "it is really a long relay race."

items.q: The relay race image suggests that the author would most likely DISAGREE with…
options: "The product moves from person to person."
items.why: Inferência: numa corrida de revezamento há muitos corredores — o texto mostra muitas pessoas, não uma só.

items.q: "One baton and the same finish line" suggests that…
options: they all move the same product toward the same goal
everyone works on a different product with a different goal
items.why: Inferência: um bastão e uma linha de chegada = um produto e um objetivo comum a todos.

blocks.instruction: Ouça James explicando ao novo estagiário o que é uma cadeia de suprimentos. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Okay, look at your cup of coffee. It looks simple, right? But it has a long story.

First, a farmer grows the coffee on a farm. That is the raw material. Then a truck takes the beans to a factory. The factory cleans them and roasts them. Now they are ready to sell.

Next, another truck takes the coffee to a big warehouse. The warehouse keeps it safe until a shop needs it. Then a small truck takes it to the shop near your house. Finally, you buy it. You are the customer. You are the last stop.

So one small cup passes through many hands. The farmer, the driver, the factory, the warehouse, the shop — each one adds a little value. It is like a relay race. Many runners, one baton, and you are the finish line. That is a supply chain, and it is everywhere.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What example does James use to explain the supply chain?
items.why: "look at your cup of coffee."

items.q: What is the raw material in James's story?
items.why: "a farmer grows the coffee on a farm. That is the raw material."

items.q: What does the warehouse do?
options: It sells the coffee to you
It keeps the coffee safe until a shop needs it
items.why: "The warehouse keeps it safe until a shop needs it."

items.q: James says "you are the last stop." This suggests that…
options: the farmer is the last stop
the customer comes at the end of the chain
items.why: Inferência: o cliente compra por último, então é o fim da cadeia.

items.q: What is James's main point about the small cup of coffee?
options: Simple things pass through many hands
items.why: Inferência: ele mostra que um item simples esconde uma longa cadeia de muitas pessoas.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Cotton is a raw material for shirts." A raw material is…
options: a basic thing used to make something
items.why: Raw material = matéria-prima, o material básico usado para fazer um produto.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "They keep the boxes in a big ___ until the shops need them."
items.why: Warehouse = armazém, onde os produtos ficam guardados.

items.q: "A factory turns steel into cars." A factory is a place where people…
items.why: Factory = fábrica, o lugar onde os produtos são feitos.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The last stop in the chain is the ___, the person who buys the product."
items.why: Customer = cliente, quem compra o produto no fim da cadeia.

items.q: In a relay race, runners pass a baton. A baton is…
options: a small stick they hand to the next runner
items.why: Baton = bastão, que um corredor passa para o próximo.

blocks.instruction: Expressões e phrasal verbs comuns em conversas de trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The trucker will drop off the coffee at the shop." To drop off means to…
items.why: Drop off = deixar/entregar algo num lugar.

items.q: "We are about to roll out the new coffee in every shop." To roll out means to…
items.why: Roll out = lançar/implementar aos poucos.

items.q: "The shop ran out of coffee this morning." To run out of means to…
items.why: Run out of = ficar sem algo, acabar o estoque.

items.q: "The team promised to help and they followed through." They…
items.why: Follow through = cumprir o que foi combinado até o fim.

items.q: "Every person in the chain has to do their part." This means each person must…
options: do their own share of the work
items.why: Do your part = fazer a sua parte do trabalho.
